item.title: Palm Desert Woman Killed in Rollover Crash in Anza
item.description: A woman from Palm Desert was killed in a rollover crash Wednesday morning in Anza, authorities said.According to the California Highway Patrol, 27-year-old Skylar Berry died at the scene of the crash.Investigators say the collision happened around 7 a.m. near Cary Road when Berry’s truck became uncontrollable at an unknown speed before overturning onto the shoulder of the highway. item.title: Riverside County Approves Measures to Stabilize Palo Verde Hospital
item.description: The Riverside County Board of Supervisors has approved a series of actions aimed at stabilizing Palo Verde Hospital in Blythe.In February, the board approved a $3.45 million payment that allowed the Palo Verde Health Care District to qualify for a state funding program. item.title: The Roggin Report-Thursday, March 12th, 2026
item.description: Alright, let's pull up a chair and talk about how much the world is changing right under our feet. First, let's look at the Shops at Palm Desert. item.title: Historic Plaza Theatre Reopens as Cultural and Economic Boost for Downtown Palm Springs
item.description: A historic landmark in downtown Palm Springs is once again taking center stage after a major renovation brought the iconic Plaza Theatre back to life. Originally built in 1936, the theatre has long been part of the city’s cultural identity. item.title: Digital Ghosts: Kids on the phone all day at school
item.description: Remember the days when the biggest risk in class was getting caught passing a folded piece of paper? Fast forward to 2026, and the classroom has become a "digital ghost town." A recent report from Common Sense Media highlights a staggering reality: teenagers are now receiving a median of 273 notifications a day, with a massive chunk of those hitting during school hours.
